label: Meta Ads
terms_note: Marketing API access is tiered (app review / access levels per the Meta developer docs); advertiser ToS not read this session

discovery.auth: oauth2 (user / system-user access token; ads_management, ads_read, business_management)
sdks: https://github.com/facebook/facebook-python-business-sdk (official, Python; also PHP, Java, Ruby, Node.js Business SDKs)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Marketing API on the Graph API).
auth: 1. Register an app at developers.facebook.com and add the **Marketing API** product ("To manage the Marketing API, please visit your App Dashboard and add the Marketing API product to your app" — SDK README).

2. Facebook Login (OAuth 2.0) on the user's user with `ads_management` (read + manage) or `ads_read` (reports only), plus `business_management` for Business Manager objects; exchange for a long-lived token (`/oauth/access_token?grant_type=fb_exchange_token`), or use a Business Manager **system use

3. Access tiers: **Limited Access** (default; "Heavily rate-limited per ad account. For development only", max 2 system users) → **Full Access** ("Lightly rate limited per ad account") once the app has "at least 500 Marketing API calls in the last 15 days" and "an error rate of less than 15% in the

4. Permission levels: Standard Access (own ad accounts, automatic) vs Advanced Access ("If your app is managing other people's ad accounts, you need advanced access" — App Review per permission + Business Verification).
5. Recommended: turn on "App Secret Proof for Server API calls" (appsecret_proof).

endpoints.notes: `campaign_id, daily_budget, bid_strategy, bid_amount, targeting{}, optimization_goal, billing_event, start_time, end_time, status`
`subtype CUSTOM / LOOKALIKE, customer_file_source, payload{schema, data[] hashed}`

reference.limits: - Rate limiting is per ad account (Limited vs Full tier) using the `x-business-use-case-usage` header; rate-limit errors carry code 17 / 613 / 80004. - Business Verification "if your app will access sensitive data"; App Review required for Advanced Access to `ads_management` / `ads_read`. - Ad Library: non-political ads only for EU-reached ads; impressions / spend political-only.
mcp_sdk: Official Business SDKs: Python (`pip install facebook_business`), PHP, Java, Ruby, Node.js — https://github.com/facebook/facebook-python-business-sdk.
No official MCP server; community servers exist but were not opened this pass.

fields.name: access_token
fields.help: Long-lived user or Business Manager system-user access token with ads_read (reads) and ads_management (budget updates), from an app with the Marketing API product; sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.

me.note: GET /v26.0/me?fields=id,name: the user (or system user) behind the token.

list_accounts.note: GET /me/adaccounts. `id` is the `act_<ad_account_id>` form that the other tools take as account_id; account_status 1 = ACTIVE, 2 = DISABLED, 101 = CLOSED. Up to 100 accounts (list_accounts takes no paging arguments); paging is cursor-based (paging.cursors.after), so only the first page is returned.

list_campaigns.note: GET /act_<id>/campaigns (account_id must carry the act_ prefix, as list_accounts returns it). By default only non-archived, non-deleted campaigns. `status` is not sent (the effective_status filter is a JSON list). daily_budget/lifetime_budget in raw are strings in the currency's minor unit (cents), so they are not mapped to `budget`. Paging is cursor-based; only the first page is returned.

update_budget.note: POST /{campaign_id} {daily_budget} answers {success: true}. daily_budget is an integer in the account currency's MINOR unit (e.g. 5000 = 50.00 USD) and applies only to campaigns using campaign budget (Advantage+ campaign budget); ad-set budgets are set on the ad set. `currency` is ignored (the account currency applies).

pause_resume.note: POST /{campaign_id} {status: PAUSED|ACTIVE} (pause → PAUSED, resume → ACTIVE) answers {success: true}. Pausing a campaign stops all its ad sets and ads; ARCHIVED/DELETED are not reachable from this verb.

not_offered.get_report: GET /{object_id}/insights takes a custom range only as the single object parameter `time_range={'since':YYYY-MM-DD,'until':YYYY-MM-DD}` (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/reference/ad-account/insights/: since/until are properties of that object, not parameters); the runtime cannot build it from date_from/date_to. A fixed `date_preset` (e.g. last_7d) is documented but would silently ignore the required date_from/date_to, so it is not mapped.
